properties.name: Thirukkattuppalli outfall
properties.description: Domestic sewage from Thirukkattuppalli town panchayat into the Cauvery, upstream of the regulator at Padithurai, as TNPCB's 2019 Cauvery action plan records it. The plan gives no flow or BOD for it. Position is the plan's own GPS coordinate (p.194).

properties.name: Thiruvaiyaru outfall
properties.description: Domestic sewage from Thiruvaiyaru town panchayat into the Cauvery behind the ARK Complex, 15th Madapam Street, as TNPCB's 2019 Cauvery action plan records it. The plan gives no flow or BOD for it. Position is the plan's own GPS coordinate (p.194).
